baseline_models.mechanism: The paired dwelling forms make residence inside predecessor sites the medium of disclosure: stable location is not background but a place-borne sign through which their outcome becomes manifest.

activation_trace.role: Inhabiting a dwelling supplies the embodied residence that places the addressees inside the predecessors' setting.
A locus of stability makes the inherited site itself carry the evidentiary role.
Manifest disclosure turns occupancy into recognition rather than mere co-location.
The example as lesson or sign names the readable significance of the inhabited remains.

changed_reading.before: You lived in their houses and were told what happened to them.
changed_reading.after: Your settled presence inside their sites made those sites disclose the predecessors' outcome as an inhabitable sign.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: kayfa faalna bihim wa-darabna lakumu al-amthal
baseline_models.mechanism: The adjacent clauses couple enacted outcome with displayed analogy, so the predecessors' fate can function as the deterrent exemplar rather than as information merely followed by unrelated illustrations.

activation_trace.role: An enacted work supplies the concrete outcome inflicted upon the former occupants.
Displaying and making an analogy visible converts that outcome into communicative form.
Punishment that makes its recipient an example supplies the deterrent edge of the displayed fate.
The conventional struck parable keeps the mechanism anchored in explicit figurative presentation.

changed_reading.before: The verse reports punishment and then mentions parables.
changed_reading.after: What was done to the former occupants is itself displayed alongside the parables as a deterrent exemplar.

context_deltas.mechanism: Earlier settlement language answers threatened expulsion with the removal of wrongdoers and the installation of successors, while Abraham's settlement directs habitation toward worship and gratitude. The focus dwelling is therefore charged as inherited moral tenure.

activation_trace.role: The focus inhabitation is the tenure whose moral character the earlier settlements revise.
Passage to the outside supplies the threatened dispossession that begins the transfer sequence.
Falling into destruction removes the wrongdoers whose land can then be inhabited by successors.
Promised inhabitation after the wrongdoers makes settlement an explicit succession rather than neutral residence.
Deliberate settlement by the sacred house supplies a purpose-governed counterpart to occupying the wrongdoers' dwellings.

structural_cues: 14:13-14 moves from threatened expulsion to destruction of wrongdoers and settlement after them.
14:37 places settlement in a barren valley within a sequence of prayer, provision, and gratitude.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated settlement, expulsion, destruction, and stated religious purpose; I infer that succession creates accountable tenure. A live narrower alternative is that these are historical parallels without a general tenancy rule.

changed_reading.before: Living in former wrongdoers' houses provides evidence about the past.
changed_reading.after: Living there means inheriting a transferred tenure whose purpose must be reversed rather than the former occupants' pattern repeated.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fixed and uprooted tree sequence distinguishes occupying a place from possessing durable ground. A structure can remain available for successors even when its occupants lack the sustaining root, fixed word, and settled base that confer real stability.

activation_trace.role: The focus locus of residence poses the question whether a house is also a genuine place of stability.
The tree as an origin supplies a living support structure against which inherited masonry is measured.
Durable fixity marks the good tree's root as the source of stability.
Whole-root removal supplies the failure mode that leaves the bad tree unsupported.
Fixity and settlement are explicitly absent after uprooting, separating mere location from secure ground.
Active strengthening transfers the tree's support mechanism to persons through the fixed word.

structural_cues: 14:24 gives the good tree a fixed root and an elevated branch.
14:26 removes the bad tree from above the earth and denies it any qarar; 14:27 then fixes believers by the fixed word.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a botanical support relation and explicit fixation, uprooting, and lack of settlement; I map that mechanism onto the focus contrast between dwelling and durable grounding. The alternative is to confine the tree mechanics to speech and belief.

changed_reading.before: To settle in a surviving house is to possess a stable place.
changed_reading.after: The surviving house proves that occupancy can outlast occupants, but true stability belongs to a sustaining root and fixed word, not to the structure inhabited.

context_deltas.mechanism: The claim of no removal immediately before the focus and the mountain-moving scheme immediately after it turn dwelling-stillness ironic. The addressees settle in sites that already prove occupants can be displaced, so apparent immobility contains its own reversal.

activation_trace.role: Loss of motion supplies the stillness implied by becoming settled in the inherited dwellings.
Movement after stillness exposes the denied removal latent in the claim of permanent tenure.
Departure from place or state supplies the post-focus reversal of settled location.
A solid elevated mass supplies the benchmark of apparent immovability that the scheme seeks to dislodge.

structural_cues: 14:44 recalls the addressees' oath that they would undergo no removal.
14:45 places them in the dwellings of vanished wrongdoers.
14:46 measures their scheming against the removal of mountains.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a no-removal claim, inherited dwellings, and attempted mountain removal; I read their sequence as deliberate kinetic irony. The alternative is that the two zawal statements frame separate claims without modifying sakantum.

changed_reading.before: You became established in houses whose owners had disappeared.
changed_reading.after: Your very settledness is evidence against your oath of permanence: the dwellings remain precisely because occupants can be moved out of them.

context_deltas.mechanism: The preceding vision scene separates intense ocular fixation from inward apprehension: eyes stare while hearts are empty. Against that split, tabayyana is not mere exposure to visible ruins but the demanded conversion of seeing into morally effective clarity.

activation_trace.role: Manifest disclosure anchors the focus demand that the predecessors' outcome become genuinely clear.
Inattention that leaves something outside awareness supplies the mistaken model explicitly denied of God and implicitly risked by the audience.
A fixed staring gaze supplies vision without interpretive movement.
Inner sight supplies the missing perceptual layer against which mere staring is measured.
A weakened or absent heart supplies the failed interior uptake of what the eyes confront.
Air or emptiness gives the heart's failure a spatial image: visible input reaches an unoccupied interior.

structural_cues: 14:42 denies divine inattention and delays the wrongdoers to a day of fixed eyes.
14:42-43 intensifies visual attention while denying return of the glance and depicting hearts as air.
14:45 then states that the former occupants' treatment had become clear to the audience.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies staring eyes, inner sight as a branch, emptied hearts, and focus disclosure; I infer that tabayyana requires inward uptake of visible evidence. A live alternative is that the judgment vision and the focus audience are too distinct for this perceptual transfer.

changed_reading.before: The addressees had enough visible information to know what happened.
changed_reading.after: The ruins had become outwardly manifest, but the verse presses for an inward clarity that habitation and staring alone do not guarantee.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah repeatedly returns liability to the self and closes with each self receiving what it acquired. This joins the focus's divine action and reflexive wrongdoing into a causal circuit: what was done to them discloses what their own action made return to its bearer.

activation_trace.role: The self as the very entity harmed anchors reflexive liability in the focus.
Blame directed to the selves themselves supplies an earlier explicit return of responsibility to its bearer.
Matching an act with its recompense supplies the return relation.
Each self as a whole entity is the individual endpoint of that recompense.
Acquiring a gain through one's own pursuit supplies the action attributed to the recompensed self.
Counting and reckoning closes the mechanism as an exact account rather than diffuse collective consequence.

structural_cues: 14:22 commands the followers to blame their own selves rather than the inviter.
14:34 characterizes the human as intensively wrongdoing and ungrateful.
14:51 closes the judgment sequence with each self recompensed for what it earned and with swift reckoning.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies reflexive harm, self-blame, earning, matched recompense, and reckoning; I infer a causal return connecting their act to what God did to them. The alternative keeps divine punishment and human earning as parallel descriptions without a single circuit.

changed_reading.before: They harmed themselves, and God separately punished them.
changed_reading.after: Their very selves became both the bearers of acquired action and the endpoints of its exact return, which is what the disclosed divine treatment makes visible.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it carries the concrete wrong-place branch of zulm into the neighboring dwelling construction. It remains anchored in zalamu anfusahum and the repeated s-k-n locus, but downstream prose should present it as a spatial branch overlay, not as the lexical translation of zulm.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: zalamu anfusahum beside sakantum fi masakinihim

activation_trace.role: Putting a thing in the wrong place or time spatializes the wrong done.
The self as the very entity makes the wrongly placed object the wrongdoers themselves.
The successors' locus of stability is the former occupants' now-vacated place.

changed_reading.before: They wronged themselves, and later people happened to live in their houses.
changed_reading.after: Their wrongdoing can be imaged as misplacing their very selves until their places stand apart from them and become the successors' dwellings.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it lets the impact branch of daraba and the punitive-exemplar branch of mathal resonate through a standard parable construction. The adjacent faalna bihim and the material destruction images keep it anchored, but downstream prose must call it an undertone and must not replace the ordinary sense of striking or presenting parables.

activation_trace.role: Impact of one thing upon another lends physical force to the presentation of examples.
Punitive treatment that makes someone an example lets the treated predecessors resonate as embodied deterrents.
Ash left by burning gives an earlier parable a material residue of destruction.
Whole-root extraction gives another parable a materially enacted ruin mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Parables verbally illustrate the punishment of prior peoples.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the prior peoples and their material remains resonate as bodies struck into exemplary form, while the construction still means that parables were presented.

strongest_changes: Settlement became accountable succession rather than neutral residence.
The fixed and uprooted tree sequence separated occupancy from genuine stability.
Zawal on both sides of the focus made sakan ironic: claimed permanence contains removal.
Self-wronging closed into earned and individually reckoned return.
summary.what_was_special: The whole-surah packet exposed a repeated settlement-transfer pattern, a botanical mechanics of stability, a direct sakan-zawal reversal around the focus, and a final self-accounting closure that a local reading would not hold together.
remaining_uncertainties: The settlement parallels may mark historical succession without establishing a general rule of conditional tenure.
The punitive mathal branch may supply only an undertone in the conventional daraba al-amthal construction.
The fixed-eye and empty-heart scene may not directly characterize the addressees of 14:45.
